dish.title: Polish Bigos: Hunter's Stew of Sauerkraut, Cabbage, Kielbasa, and Pork

recipe_version.title: Polish Bigos: Hunter's Stew of Sauerkraut, Cabbage, Kielbasa, and Pork
recipe_version.description: Poland's slow-simmered hunter's stew of sauerkraut and fresh cabbage with browned pork shoulder, smoked kielbasa, dried porcini, prunes, onion, tomato paste, bay, and allspice, cooked until deep, tangy, and savory. Served with rye bread.

ingredients.name: smoked Polish kielbasa
ingredients.display_name: smoked kielbasa whose label lists pork, salt, spices, garlic, and curing agents only

ingredients.name: sauerkraut
ingredients.display_name: refrigerated sauerkraut whose label lists cabbage and salt only

ingredients.name: rye bread
ingredients.display_name: rye bread whose label lists rye flour, wheat flour, water, yeast, salt, and caraway only

steps.title: Soak and prep
steps.body: Soak the porcini in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cube the pork and season with the salt and pepper, slice the kielbasa, drain and chop the sauerkraut, shred the cabbage, chop the onion, and halve the prunes. Lift out the porcini, chop them, and keep the soaking liquid, leaving any grit behind.

steps.title: Brown the meats
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the pork in two batches, about 6 minutes per batch, then brown the kielbasa 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.

steps.title: Cook the onion and cabbage
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the fresh cabbage and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 6 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Add the sauerkraut, porcini and their soaking liquid, prunes, bay leaves, allspice, 2 cups water, and the browned meats with their juices.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over low, stirring every 20 minutes or so, until the pork is tender and the stew is thick and brown, about 1 1/2 hours. Uncover for the last 15 minutes if it is still loose.

steps.title: Slice the bread
steps.body: While the stew simmers, slice the rye bread (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the bay leaves and allspice berries if you can find them. Ladle into bowls and serve with rye bread.
